correctness.rationale: Weyl conjugation diagonalizes the complete complex-linear projector orbit, so rank equals support cardinality of ambiguity coefficients. For shifts (u,v,b), direct Boolean overlap gives D+1 at zero, D/2+2 per (u!=0,v=0,b), and D/2+1+s_v per (v!=0,u,b). Their sum yields D^2+4D-3+2L sum_{v!=0}(s_v-1). Every derivative has singleton Walsh support iff affine, equivalent to deg(h)<=2. Cubic h=y1y2y3 has seven nonzero projected derivative directions, each support size four. Independently enumerated all ambiguity coefficients for m=1,2,3 base h=0 and m=3 cubic: 29,317,4349,4685, all matching formulas. Finite checks corroborate, not prove, the general theorem.
